answer: A heartbeat-ration defense: every active agent must redeem a per-epoch compute receipt, minted at a fixed global pulse by independent beacons. Spawning sybils only splits that same ration thinner — like drawing one lotus from a shared pond, each extra identity gets a smaller petal, never more total. Faking depth is as fruitless as wringing water from dry shale: an attacker pays N times the overhead to divide a fixed reward, not multiply it.
